About Azad Global Trade

INDIA'S FINEST,
WORLD'S TRUSTED

Azad Global Trade is a leading export-import company based in India, specializing in agricultural products, traditional handicrafts, and sustainable eco-friendly goods. We bridge India's incredible diversity of produce and craftsmanship with discerning global markets.

Our network spans 200+ farmer cooperatives and artisan clusters across 12 Indian states. By eliminating middlemen, we ensure fair prices for producers and competitive pricing for buyers — without ever compromising on quality.

Every shipment undergoes multi-stage quality inspection in our processing facilities, backed by complete documentation and certifications required by destination countries.

Our Mission

To make India's premium products accessible to global markets with transparency, quality, and fairness.

Our Vision

To be India's most trusted export partner — recognized for quality, reliability, and sustainable practices.

Supply Chain

FARM TO CONTAINER

A transparent, quality-controlled pipeline ensuring every product meets international standards before it leaves Indian shores.

1

Source

Direct partnerships with 200+ farmer co-ops & artisan clusters. No middlemen.

2

Inspect

Multi-stage lab testing: moisture, purity, grade, pesticide residue. Batch certified.

3

Process

Quality-controlled processing. Custom packing, private labeling, barcoding per buyer specs.

4

Document

Phytosanitary, COO, bill of lading, insurance — complete export documentation.

5

Deliver

FOB/CIF/DDP to your port or warehouse. End-to-end tracking & post-delivery support.

The Azad Advantage

WHY GLOBAL BUYERS CHOOSE US

Quality Guarantee

Every shipment backed by lab reports, grade certificates, and a replacement guarantee. Zero tolerance for substandard output.

Direct Sourcing

No middlemen. Direct from farmer cooperatives and artisan clusters — better pricing for buyers, fair income for producers.

Compliance Ready

Complete export documentation, phytosanitary certificates, and regulatory paperwork handled by our team for every destination market.

Sustainability Focus

Ethical sourcing, fair trade practices, eco-conscious packaging. Helping buyers meet ESG commitments effortlessly.

98% On-Time Delivery

Dedicated logistics team manages freight, customs, and last-mile to ensure deadlines are consistently met.

Dedicated Support

Each client gets a dedicated account manager. WhatsApp, email, or call — 48-hour response, 365 days a year.
